segments.text: How old were you when you found out that if you mixed three eggs into Greek yogurt,
whisk it together with shredded coconut and a little vanilla, then pour it into a mold,
bake it for 30 minutes, and let it chill. You end up with a fluffy coconut cake. It not only
tastes amazing, but it is light on the stomach, loaded with healthy fats, and will not send your
blood sugar through the roof, baby. And the best part? The eggs and yogurt carry a massive dose of
protein. No refined sugar, no flour, high protein. I got recipes like this for every sweet treat you
can think of. Comment yes if you want more recipes like this and follow me so you do not miss a single
one.
